subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘ADVANCE’ is written as ‘VDAAECN’ and ‘BABYSIT’ is written as ‘BABYTIS’. How will ‘AFFABLE’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position of the English alphabet letters is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

‘ADVANCE’ is written as ‘VDAAECN’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5da1b52d431be9233c3938a067ec119bce2e3bffb7606fe0e258e2485814b032.png] 

And,

‘BABYSIT’ is written as ‘BABYTIS’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0334175064c8e1ab786de60f04508d077dce99aba28d3802e6804246482b5ad6.png] 

Similarly,

‘AFFABLE’ be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba78961d626f6828af217a95c497ffa03eb133082ad06a45dbec80cd1219a4af.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"FFAAELB".**
